name: Oglala Sioux Tribe (Pine Ridge Reservation, United States)
description: A red field charged with a circle of eight white tipis, their tops pointing outward.
history: The flag of the Oglala Sioux Tribe was adopted in 1961; the eight tipis stand for the eight districts of the Pine Ridge Reservation, the red field for the blood shed by the Lakota.

features.role: eight tipis arranged in a circle
